name: Secyllia Forle
source:
A girl who works at a perfume shop in the capital. A celestial spirit perfumer who borrows the power of celestial spirits to create scents with healing powers.

She likes interacting with star spirits and compounding them, and she works hard every day to become a full-fledged perfumer.

[Translated from [url=http://comodo.starfree.jp/perfumer/chara.html]official website[/url]]
